advisory.summary: Hardcoded role name string gates company tab
advisory.details: user?.clientRoleName === 'Partner Admin' — hardcoded role name. Per project conventions (permissions-and-feature-flags.md Rule 4), role name strings should not be used for gating. However this is an intentional design decision by the developer and no dedicated 'show company tab' permission exists. Left as advisory.

findings.summary: Tenant catalog config reads flattened fields but contract returns nested tenantConfig
findings.details: TenantCatalogItemResponse uses flat fields (configId, enabled, overrides at root) while the contract YAML defines tenantConfig: ClientCatalogItemConfigResponse | null (nested). If the contract is authoritative, switches could render disabled and override panels empty.
findings.tierReason: alreadyHandled=true — commit 1d38ac0 explicitly flattened type to match actual backend flat response shape; all consumers updated consistently; pre-existing from redemption-catalog, not introduced by redemption-history; contract YAML is stale
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the contract YAML with the actual backend shape. If backend is flat, update redemption-catalog.yaml. If backend is nested, update FE type and consumers back to nested tenantConfig structure.

classificationRules.blockingThreshold: severity critical/high AND confidence >= 0.70 AND not alreadyHandled
classificationRules.advisoryThreshold: severity medium/low OR confidence < 0.70 OR alreadyHandled
